mods.name: Cytra Area Scanner
mods.changelog:
- Enabled switch (Scanner tab): off stops the running scan, the overlay, the HUD and the scan hotkeys. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

Needs Litematica 0.26.16+ and MaLiLib 0.27.20+.

mods.name: Cytra Bot Macros
mods.changelog:
- Client on/off switch: clientEnabled in config.json and /bm enable | /bm disable. Off: keys, hotkeys, quick add and starting macros from this client do nothing; running and server macros keep going. Cytra Hub uses it for the on/off switch and profiles
- Mod icon (Cytra logo)

mods.name: Cytra Carpet
mods.changelog: Trash filter: /cytra trash deletes listed mined drops (netherrack, cobble, tuff...) instead of collecting them, with carefulBreak, shulkerMining or shulkerPickup. New rule trashFilter (off by default).

mods.name: Cytra Container
mods.changelog:
- Dump into shulker boxes inside dump containers, including splitting empty boxes off Carpet's stacked shulker boxes

Client needs Litematica 0.26.16+ and MaLiLib 0.27.20+. The server part is optional.

mods.name: Cytra Creative
mods.changelog:
First release: a creative-server (CMP) toolkit; every feature is a module you switch on and off with /cc modules.
- Regions and a selection wand, particle outlines, map-style and 3D renders, .litematic copy and paste with undo
- Creative Guard: per-region rules for building, explosions, fire, fluids, pistons, mob spawning and more
- Lab: private test dimensions with their own tick rate, world border and snapshots
- Build Share + Gallery, Scale Model, Showcase, Timelapse (GIF) and Camera flight paths

Install on the server with Fabric API. Players don't need it; with it (and MaLiLib) they get the menu (/cc menu) and smooth camera playback.

mods.name: Cytra Hub
mods.changelog: Updates tab: unlisted mods are only shown as updates to players who already have them, never as an install.

mods.name: Cytra Mass Craft
mods.changelog: Craft what's missing (setting, off by default): a Craft missing button crafts the shortfall of the open Litematica material list from inventory + linked storage; uncraftable items listed in chat.

mods.name: Cytra Send
mods.changelog: First release: the SMP side of Cytra Creative labs. Select an area (/cc send wand, or pos1/pos2) and run /cc send <name>; the bridge bot carries it to the CMP, where it becomes a lab with a [Go to lab] button. Up to 1024x1024, every height, unloaded chunks too.

mods.name: Cytra Waypoints
mods.changelog: Renamed to Cytra Waypoints (was SharedWaypoints). Same mod: waypoints, settings, permissions, /cway and Xaero's Shared set all carry over. New jar name cytra-waypoints-2.7.0.jar; the Hub swaps the old jar for you.

mods.name: Cytra-Syncmatica
mods.changelog:
- Chunk Claims screen: drag to claim chunks with a description, or release them
- Warning when a schematic is placed in someone else's claimed area
- Previews can be drawn from other angles
- Previews of .schem and .nbt files

mods.name: CytraBackups
mods.changelog: - New mod icon: the Cytra logo (Mod Menu, Cytra Hub). No other changes.

mods.name: CytraTrades
mods.changelog: - Auto-supply (optional, needs Cytra Container): when a trade runs out of emeralds, pull more from your linked storage (loose and from shulker boxes) and keep trading. Off by default; set emeralds per refill in the config. Works exactly as before without Cytra Container.

mods.name: StickyToggle
mods.changelog:
- Mod icon (Cytra logo) in Mod Menu. No other changes.

One jar for client and server.
